findings.message: Isolate BRAVE_API_KEY before exercising the missing-key web case.
findings.rationale: The test leaves the process environment unchanged. When the vault and legacy lookup return no key, webSearchTool falls back to BRAVE_API_KEY and calls the real search service. With a valid environment key and successful response, success is true and this assertion fails. Clear and restore the environment variable or intercept the HTTP request so the test remains deterministic and local.

testCoverage.explanation: Inspected all three consumer test bodies and assertions, the preload and daemon helper, and inventory verification assertions. Notify asserts delivery using the vault value; web asserts a vault-backed miss and legacy lookup; keys.list/get assert returned values and one vault read. Empty-secret presence and rejected non-string writes across restart have direct assertions. The module comment covers cooldown and legacy retention. All 13 refreshed inventory entries have matching committed source hashes, internally consistent counts and site digests; the session fixture's changed source hashes also match. The web test's environment dependency is reported as a finding. The planned real-Keychain check remains unexecuted; that does not prevent completing this coverage review.
